# Group Event 7 – Parallelogram OABC

## Setting Up the Problem

From the diagram of parallelogram $OABC$ (with $O$ at the origin and $A$ on the positive $x$-axis), the perpendicular from $C$ to the $x$-axis creates a right triangle with:
- Horizontal leg $= 3$
- Vertical leg $= 4$
- Base $OA = a$

The angle $\theta = \angle AOC$ is at vertex $O$.

## G7.1 – Find $a$

The side $OC$ has horizontal component $3$ and vertical component $4$, so:

$$OC = \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5$$

From the diagram, $OA = OC = 5$ (the parallelogram's sides give):

$$\boxed{a = 5}$$

## G7.2 – Find $b$

The value $b$ is the **height** of the parallelogram (the vertical component of $OC$):

$$\boxed{b = 4}$$

## G7.3 – Find the Area of $OABC$

$$\text{Area} = \text{base} \times \text{height} = a \times b = 5 \times 4$$

$$\boxed{\text{Area} = 20}$$

## G7.4 – Find $\tan\theta$

The angle $\theta = \angle AOC$ is the angle between $\overrightarrow{OA}$ (along the $x$-axis) and $\overrightarrow{OC}$. In the right triangle formed by dropping the perpendicular from $C$:

$$\tan\theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}} = \frac{4}{3}$$

$$\boxed{\tan\theta = \dfrac{4}{3}}$$
